title: Grandpa Has Told This Story 998 TIMES 📖
description:
In our river town, any story told a thousand times happens, exactly the way the thousandth ends. People here are careful what they repeat.

My grandpa runs the tackle shop on the river. One night, through the window, I saw him telling a story to my empty chair with his eyes shut, and a number chalked by the till.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
